clauses.clause: Sole clause: amends sec. 2 of EO 11248 by adding item (10), Director, Demonstration Cities Administration, HUD, to level V of the Federal Executive Salary Schedule

data_errors: The evidence slice lists no later instruments naming this order and routes only EO 11708; EO 11542 (held at jobs/fr-originals/output/texts/EO_11542.txt), which deleted the very item EO 11316 added, is not linked. It names EO 11248 sec. 2 item (10), not EO 11316 by number.
The OFR 1989 table disposition 'Revoked by EO 11708' gives the 1973 revocation of the parent as amended; the order's only clause had already been deleted on 1970-07-02 by EO 11542.
OCR in the held EO 11542 text prints the order number as 'T1542' (location confidence marked medium); the operative words are legible.

moves.note: Federal Register printing 31 FR 15011 held (OCR legible); the order has one operative clause, an amendment adding item (10) to sec. 2 of EO 11248.
NO. EO 11542 (1970-07-02) expressly deleted the item (10) this order added; the parent EO 11248 as amended was then revoked by EO 11708 sec. 3 (1973-03-23).
The single clause ended 1970-07-02 by EO 11542.
No open gap. The substituted position (Deputy Assistant Secretary for Model Cities) was saved by EO 11708 sec. 2(8) and deleted by EO 11715; all quotations are from held FR texts.

propositions.claim: EO 11316 is an amendment-only order adding one item to sec. 2 of EO 11248.
propositions.quote: Section 2 of Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10,1965, as amended, is further amended by adding thereto the follow ing

propositions.claim: The item added is the Director of the Demonstration Cities Administration, HUD.
propositions.quote: (10) Director, Demonstration Cities Administration, Department of Housing and Urban Development.

propositions.claim: EO 11542 of July 2, 1970 expressly deleted the item (10) that EO 11316 added, substituting a different position.
propositions.quote: is further amended by deleting “ (10) Director, Demonstration Cities Adminis­tration, Department of Housing and Urban Development”, and insert­ing in lieu thereof the following

propositions.claim: EO 11708 of March 23, 1973 revoked the parent EO 11248 as amended, saving only the positions listed in its own sec. 2.
propositions.quote: Except with respect to the positions enumerated in section 2 o f this order, Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965, as amended, is hereby revoked.

propositions.claim: EO 11708 sec. 2 does not list the Director, Demonstration Cities Administration; it lists only the substituted Model Cities position.
propositions.quote: (8) Deputy Assistant Secretary for Model Cities, Department of Housing and Urban Development.

propositions.claim: EO 11715 of April 24, 1973 deleted the substituted Model Cities position from EO 11708 sec. 2, so no saved residue remains.
propositions.quote: is amended by deleting “ (8 ) Deputy Assistant Secretary for Model Cities, Department of Housing and Urban Development.”

review.conclusion_reason: NO is supported by the exact deletion of the sole added item on July 2, 1970. Apply the amendment-only parent rule together with the express deletion: EO 11542 names the parent and item, rather than EO 11316 itself. Formal revoked-or-superseded status is additionally supported by EO 11708's express revocation of the parent as amended, with no exception for the original position. The first operative ending and later formal disposition are distinct.

verdicts.reason: Held EO 11316 text contains one operative provision: adding an item to section 2 of EO 11248, as amended.
The added item expressly reads '(10) Director, Demonstration Cities Administration, Department of Housing and Urban Development.'

Held EO 11542, dated July 2, 1970, expressly deletes the exact item added by EO 11316 and inserts the Deputy Assistant Secretary for Model Cities position. OCR corruption does not obscure the operative words.
EO 11708 section 3 expressly revokes EO 11248 'as amended,' except for positions enumerated in section 2; its signature date is March 23, 1973.

Checked the complete section 2 list across both held pages. It includes the Model Cities position at item (8) and omits the Demonstration Cities Director. 'Only' is supported in the context of these two positions, not as a description of the entire list.

EO 11715 paragraph 2 expressly deletes section 2 item (8) of EO 11708 and is dated April 24, 1973. This removes the identified successor position; the original EO 11316 item had already ended in 1970.
